name: agent-desktop
description: Computer use CLI for AI agents
readmeExcerpt:
# agent-desktop Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree.

agent-desktop gives an AI agent computer use without screenshots or pixel matching. It reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON, with a ref for every element the agent can act on. The agent clicks or types on a ref, reads the UI again to check the result, and repeats. The loop lives in your agent; agent-desktop has no model inside. It ships as a CLI and a C library. Snapshots, clipboard reads, screenshots, command output, and debug artifacts can contain private desktop content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads. ## Install ```bash npm install -g agent-desktop agent-desktop status # platform, permissions, supported surfaces agent-desktop permissions --guide # macOS: walks you through the Accessibility grant ``` Bun, Yarn and pnpm can install the same package. It includes native binaries and platform helpers for x64 and ARM64. For direct execution without a JavaScript launcher, download the matching native archive from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-desktop/releases) and keep its helper beside the executable. On macOS and Linux, Homebrew also works: `brew install agent-desktop`. There is no official Scoop package yet. The repository no longer maintains a custom Homebrew tap or Scoop bucket. Release archives and building from source are covered in [Installation](https://agent-browser.dev/desktop/installation). ## Quick start ```bash agent-desktop snapshot --app Finder -i # interactive elements, each with a ref agent-desktop click @s8f3k2p9:e8 # act on a ref from that snapshot agent-desktop snapshot --app Finder -i # observe again to verify ``` Each command prints one JSON envelope. analysis.oneLine: agent-desktop 是一个面向 AI 编程工作流的规则与提示词资产，适合用于提升 Claude Code 或同类编码 Agent 的执行稳定性。
analysis.problem: AI 编程工具容易在上下文、测试、回滚和任务边界上犯重复错误，需要可复用的工程约束
analysis.audience: 使用 AI 编程的开发者、技术负责人、希望建立团队级 AI 编码规范的小团队
detailParagraphs: agent-desktop 更准确地说是一个面向 AI 编程工作流的规则与提示词资产，而不是一个只因为短期热度上榜的仓库。对国内用户来说，判断重点不应停留在 README 的自我描述，而要看它是否能解决一个真实、可复用、可持续维护的工作流问题：AI 编程工具容易在上下文、测试、回滚和任务边界上犯重复错误，需要可复用的工程约束。
如果把它放进实际使用场景，agent-desktop 的价值主要来自提升 Claude Code 或同类编码 Agent 的执行稳定性。当前 Star 约 22,804，说明它已经具备一定社区关注度，但商业用户更需要继续验证三件事：是否能嵌入现有业务流程，是否能由团队基于 Rust 技术栈持续维护，以及是否能形成稳定交付而不是一次性 Demo。
从商业化和私有化角度看，它更像知识资产而非软件系统，价值在于能否转化为团队开发规范、评审清单或定制化 Agent 工作流。无需复杂部署，但需要根据团队技术栈、代码规范和安全要求改写后才能稳定使用。当前最需要警惕的是：风险在于规则泛化过度，直接复制可能不适合本地项目；需要结合真实仓库测试迭代。因此建议先用一个小范围真实任务做部署测试，再决定它适合作为内部工具、客户方案组件，还是仅作为趋势观察样本。
